text:
maria_docs: FYI found a failing docs CI job: console/observability/examples/route-costs.md uses deprecated key `metrics.cost_per_token`.
devon_sdk: ah ok, that was renamed in infra/schema#102 to `metrics.unit_cost`. can you paste the snippet?
maria_docs: here:
```
- metric: metrics.cost_per_token
  aggregate: avg
  label: avg cost
```
should be `metrics.unit_cost` and label `avg cost per unit`.
jia_prod: do we need to update any exported dashboards? quick grep shows assets/route-costs-2025.png but it's generic.
devon_sdk: i'll open a tiny PR to update the snippet and add a comment `# deprecated: metrics.cost_per_token` so searches will find it.
devon_sdk: PR: #4120  updates two snippets, adds docs/deprecated_keys.txt and a grep check in scripts/docs_smoke.sh
maria_docs: can the smokecheck read a list instead of hardcoding? we should maintain that list in docs/ for now.
doc-bot: [ci/docs] build failed 1738524721  unknown metric 'metrics.cost_per_token'
devon_sdk: pushed follow-up commit to fix the last snippet. also added CHANGELOG entry under docs.
doc-bot: [ci/docs] build passed 1738524849 :tada:
maria_docs: LGTM. i'll add a one-paragraph note to console/observability/migration.md explaining the rename and linking infra/schema#102.
jia_prod: thanks, agreed we should also propose adding these deprecated keys to the infra shared list.
maria_docs: filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/420 to track that.
